title: Design System: CACiC Event Manager Admin

title.purpose: Page headings and strong task hierarchy.

body.purpose: Forms, instructions, records, and status copy.

code.purpose: Code and markdown technical content only.

shadows.name: temporary-navigation-overlay
shadows.purpose: Clarifies the automatic desktop rail while it temporarily overlays content.

motion.name: workspace-navigation
motion.purpose: Expands navigation labels and the temporary overlay. Reduced-motion preference sets this to 0ms.

components.name: Workspace Panel
components.description: The flat outlined container for one inventory or editor region.
components.css: .ds-workspace-panel { min-width: 0; padding: 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--mat-sys-outline-variant); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--mat-sys-surface); color: var(--mat-sys-on-surface); } .ds-workspace-panel h3 { margin: 0; font: var(--mat-sys-title-medium); } .ds-workspace-panel p { margin: 0.25rem 0 0; color: var(--mat-sys-on-surface-variant); font: var(--mat-sys-body-medium); } .ds-workspace-panel:hover { border-color: var(--mat-sys-outline-variant); } .ds-workspace-panel:focus-within { outline: auto; }

components.name: Workspace Record
components.description: The full-width primary selection target in an operational inventory.
components.css: .ds-workspace-record { display: grid; gap: 0.25rem; width: 100%; min-height: 64px; padding: 0.75rem; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--mat-sys-on-surface); text-align: start; } .ds-workspace-record strong { font: var(--mat-sys-title-small); } .ds-workspace-record span { color: var(--mat-sys-on-surface-variant); font: var(--mat-sys-body-small); } .ds-workspace-record:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--mat-sys-on-surface) 8%, transparent); } .ds-workspace-record:focus-visible { outline: auto; } .ds-workspace-record:active { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--mat-sys-on-surface) 12%, transparent); }

components.name: Selected Workspace Record
components.description: A record with a persistent selected state rather than decorative emphasis.
components.css: .ds-workspace-record-selected { display: grid; gap: 0.25rem; width: 100%; min-height: 64px; padding: 0.75rem; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--mat-sys-secondary-container); color: var(--mat-sys-on-secondary-container); text-align: start; } .ds-workspace-record-selected strong { font: var(--mat-sys-title-small); } .ds-workspace-record-selected span { font: var(--mat-sys-body-small); } .ds-workspace-record-selected:hover { background: var(--mat-sys-secondary-container); } .ds-workspace-record-selected:focus-visible { outline: auto; } .ds-workspace-record-selected:active { background: var(--mat-sys-secondary-container); }

components.name: Sidebar Context Selector
components.description: The first sidebar control; it opens the context dialog and renders saved context emoji with Twemoji in the application.
components.css: .ds-context-selector { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; width: 100%; min-height: 56px; padding: 0 1rem; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--mat-sys-on-surface); text-align: start; } .ds-context-selector-icon { flex: 0 0 24px; width: 24px; height: 24px; fill: currentColor; } .ds-context-selector span { min-width: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; font: var(--mat-sys-title-small); } .ds-context-selector:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--mat-sys-on-surface) 8%, transparent); } .ds-context-selector:focus-visible { outline: auto; } .ds-context-selector:active { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--mat-sys-on-surface) 12%, transparent); }

components.name: Context Search Dialog
components.description: A viewport-capped Material dialog with lazy hierarchy paging, parent-scoped child browsing, and backend-ranked metadata search.
components.html: Escolher contexto
components.css: .ds-context-dialog { display: grid; gap: 1rem; width: min(640px, calc(100vw - 2rem)); max-height: calc(100dvh - 2rem); padding: 1.5rem; border-radius: var(--mat-dialog-container-shape, 28px); background: var(--mat-sys-surface-container-high); color: var(--mat-sys-on-surface); } .ds-context-dialog h2 { margin: 0; font: var(--mat-sys-headline-small); } .ds-context-dialog label { display: grid; gap: 0.25rem; font: var(--mat-sys-label-large); } .ds-context-dialog input { min-height: 56px; padding: 0 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--mat-sys-outline); border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; color: var(--mat-sys-on-surface); font: var(--mat-sys-body-large); } .ds-context-dialog > button { min-height: 64px; padding: 0.75rem; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--mat-sys-on-surface); text-align: start; font: var(--mat-sys-title-small); } .ds-context-dialog footer { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; } .ds-context-dialog footer button { min-height: 40px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: var(--mat-sys-primary); } .ds-context-dialog button:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--mat-sys-on-surface) 8%, transparent); } .ds-context-dialog input:focus-visible, .ds-context-dialog button:focus-visible { outline: auto; } .ds-context-dialog button:active { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--mat-sys-on-surface) 12%, transparent); }

components.name: Active Navigation Item
components.description: The current global destination or context operation in the compact desktop navigation rail.
components.css: .ds-navigation-item-active { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 48px; height: 48px; padding: 0 1rem; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--mat-sys-secondary-container); color: var(--mat-sys-on-secondary-container); font: var(--mat-sys-label-large); text-decoration: none; } .ds-navigation-item-active:hover { background: var(--mat-sys-secondary-container); } .ds-navigation-item-active:focus-visible { outline: auto; } .ds-navigation-item-active:active { background: var(--mat-sys-secondary-container); }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: A Material-shaped search input for a bounded server-backed inventory or context dialog.
components.css: .ds-search-field { display: grid; gap: 0.25rem; color: var(--mat-sys-on-surface); font: var(--mat-sys-label-large); } .ds-search-field input { min-height: 56px; padding: 0 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--mat-sys-outline); border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; color: var(--mat-sys-on-surface); font: var(--mat-sys-body-large); } .ds-search-field input:hover { border-color: var(--mat-sys-on-surface); } .ds-search-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--mat-sys-primary); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-search-field input:active { border-color: var(--mat-sys-primary); }

components.name: Context Notice
components.description: A calm informational message inside a working flow.
components.html: A seleção limita a lista sem remover o acesso global.
components.css: .ds-context-notice { margin: 0; padding: 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--mat-sys-outline-variant); border-radius: 8px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--mat-sys-primary) 8%, var(--mat-sys-surface)); color: var(--mat-sys-on-surface-variant); font: var(--mat-sys-body-medium); } .ds-context-notice:hover { border-color: var(--mat-sys-outline-variant); } .ds-context-notice:focus-visible { outline: auto; }

components.name: Risk Summary
components.description: An adjacent consequence summary for a high-impact operation.
components.html:
Revise antes de continuar

Esta ação afeta os registros do contexto selecionado.
components.css: .ds-risk-summary { padding: 0.875rem; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--mat-sys-error) 35%, var(--mat-sys-outline-variant)); border-radius: 8px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--mat-sys-error) 7%, var(--mat-sys-surface)); color: var(--mat-sys-on-surface); } .ds-risk-summary strong { font: var(--mat-sys-title-small); } .ds-risk-summary p { margin: 0.25rem 0 0; color: var(--mat-sys-on-surface-variant); font: var(--mat-sys-body-medium); } .ds-risk-summary:hover { border-color: var(--mat-sys-error); } .ds-risk-summary:focus-visible { outline: auto; }

narrative.overview:
The admin is a practical working surface for people maintaining events, records, permissions, communications, and high-impact operations. It should feel quiet, trustworthy, and ready for repeated use: compact enough for dense work, with clear hierarchy and enough space to prevent mistakes.

The visual world remains close to Angular Material. Inter, semantic Material 3 colors, light and dark system themes, outlined panels, and familiar controls carry the interface. The event workspace adds a stable operational context to the shell and incorporates each event editor into its scope home; it does not add a second visual identity or a second navigation bar above each task.
keyCharacteristics: Semantic Material color roles that adapt to light and dark themes.
A sidebar context selector that turns global navigation into a focused operations menu with the editor in the scope overview.
Compact, top-aligned workspaces with clear list-and-detail structure.
Visible permission, loading, draft, publication, and consequence states.
Bounded server search with keyboard-safe dialogs and independent editor state.
Named Twemoji hierarchy shortcuts that browse only valid children and return directly to the immediate parent.
Lazy hierarchical context pages and backend-ranked search results with visible ancestry and metadata.

rules.name: The Semantic Color Rule
rules.body: App-owned styles use Material system roles; theme-specific literals are limited to content that owns an independent palette, such as syntax highlighting.

rules.name: The Selection Has Meaning Rule
rules.body: Secondary-container color always communicates the active destination or selected record.

rules.name: The Operational Copy Rule
rules.body: Interface strings are concrete Brazilian Portuguese labels that name the task, state, scope, or consequence.

rules.name: The Context Lives in Navigation Rule
rules.body: The shell owns event context and operation switching. Scoped pages do not repeat it as a top tab bar or page-level context header.

rules.name: The Flat at Rest Rule
rules.body: Prefer borders and tonal surfaces; reserve shadow for a temporary layer that physically overlaps another region.

dos: Do keep the selected context, navigation mode, visible menu, current route, list query, page, record selection, and editor state as separate concepts.
Do let the sidebar context selector open a bounded, keyboard-safe search dialog and return to the corresponding operation when possible.
Do preserve actual global destinations, canonical /event-workspace/new/* creation routes, and legacy deep links through redirects.
Do keep /certificates focused on standalone certificate folders, while event, group, and major-event certificate routes inherit their fixed context from the URL.
Do prefill parent associations when creating an event from a group or major event, or a group from a major event.
Do constrain child context dialogs to the requested parent and child kind, without unrelated results.
Do keep root, child-branch, and ranked-search cursors independent and preserve backend relevance order.
Do retain draft/version controls and permission-gated clone/delete actions when a catalog is hidden in a scope-home editor.
Do render saved emojis through Twemoji while preserving the existing emoji inputs.
Do reset list pagination when its query or scope changes, and keep server ordering deterministic across page boundaries.
Do restore or deliberately move focus when navigation, dialog closure, scope collapse, or a route change removes the focused element.
donts: Don't add a top operation tab bar or duplicate context header to pages already hosted by the scoped shell.
Don't make “Menu global” or “Menu do contexto” navigate, clear the selected context, or reset the current editor.
Don't hide global access inside an event-only workflow or make standalone records unreachable.
Don't use client-side filtering of the current page as a substitute for bounded server search.
Don't let a secondary row action trigger the row's main selection behavior.
Don't carry an editor selection into a different incompatible context or discard unsaved changes during a context transition.
Don't stretch short panels to the height of long editors, add nested decorative card outlines, or replace Material controls with custom equivalents.
